reviewItem.question: Does "ScrapeConfig v1alpha1 schema: allowed values changed: `spec.ovhcloudSDConfigs[].service`" mean a change to crd-field:prometheus-operator|group=monitoring.coreos.com|version=v1alpha1|kind=ScrapeConfig|path=spec.ovhcloudSDConfigs[].service (validation-tightened)?

proposed.statement: In the monitoring.coreos.com/v1alpha1 schema of scrapeconfigs.monitoring.coreos.com, the allowed values of spec.ovhcloudSDConfigs[].service changed: no enum values were removed and \"DedicatedServer\" and \"VPS\" were added, so the field is now restricted to those two values and any other value is rejected by the API server.
